answer: Each agent must post a bond from a scarce, externally costly resource, then earn access to a shared wharf by completing independently verifiable tasks; a beacon publishes the bond, task history, and any slashing after proven fraud. Splitting one identity into many does not multiply influence for free: every new account needs its own bond and must repeat the work, while a comet of fabricated accounts risks losing all posted collateral when evidence links them to the same controller.
